Name: Whoosh_Light
Description: Air moved by a jab or cross. Short, dry, no tail. The sound of missing.

Name: Whoosh_Heavy
Description: A hook, kick or knee cutting air. Lower and longer than the light one; the wind-up should be audible.

Name: Hit_Light
Description: Fist on body, jab or cross. A slap with weight behind it, not a movie punch. Dry.

Name: Hit_Heavy
Description: Hook, kick or knee landing. Deep, with a crack on top. This is the one the player waits for.

Name: Hit_Knockdown
Description: The blow that puts someone down. Heavier than Hit_Heavy and followed by the body hitting the ground.

Name: Block
Description: A strike caught on the forearms. Dull thud, muffled, no crack.

Name: Parry
Description: The perfect guard. Sharp and bright with a short ring -- it has to be unmistakable from Block, because it is the reward.

Name: Rage
Description: The finisher going off. Big, low, room-filling; the one sound allowed to be cinematic.

Name: Hawk_Ignite
Description: HAWK FIST lighting up: a whump of flame catching on a fist.

Name: Hawk_Hit
Description: A flaming punch landing. Hit_Heavy with a burst of fire over it.

Name: KO
Description: A fighter going down for good. Body on ground, then nothing. Not a crowd sound.

Name: Boss_Enrage
Description: A boss crossing into phase two. A roar, or a breath drawn -- it should make the player step back.

Name: Dash
Description: A dodge dash. Feet scraping and a short rush of cloth.

Name: Dash_Leap
Description: The dash once DASH LEAP is held: the same scrape, then a beat of nothing before the landing.

Name: Footstep
Description: One step on the stage floor. Fired from the walk animation's notify. Wide pitch range so a walk cycle never sounds looped.

Name: Land
Description: Feet hitting the ground after a leap or a knockback.

Name: Gate_Strike
Description: A strike landing on a shutter or a cracked wall that has not given yet. Metal or stone taking a hit and holding.

Name: Gate_Break
Description: The third strike: a shutter tearing off its rails, or masonry coming down. Debris after.

Name: Gate_Open
Description: A ledge climbed, a gap crossed, a locker opened -- the quiet gates. A latch, a scrape, a hand on stone.

Name: Talent_Found
Description: A talent picked up. The biggest UI sound in the game; the world just opened.

Name: Exp_Cache
Description: XP found behind a gate. Smaller than Talent_Found; a reward, not a milestone.

Name: Exit_Travel
Description: Walking out of an area into the next. A door, a step through, a breath of the new place.

Name: Exit_Sealed
Description: A route refusing you. Solid and final -- a bolt, a hand on a locked door. Pairs with the SEALED banner.

Name: Wave_Start
Description: An ambush closing in. Low, rising, short. The arena just locked.

Name: Wave_Clear
Description: The last of a wave down and the arena unlocking. A release, not a fanfare.

Name: Stage_Clear
Description: An area beaten. This one can be a fanfare.

Name: Stage_Fail
Description: Ahmed down. Low and slow; no sting.

Name: Level_Up
Description: A rank gained from fighting. Bright, short, upward.

Name: Upgrade_Bought
Description: XP spent at the training camp. A confirm with weight; money changing hands.

Name: UI_Tap
Description: Any button. Quiet, dry, instant.

Name: UI_Back
Description: Going back a screen. UI_Tap, lower.

Name: UI_Denied
Description: A button that will not: not enough XP, a locked mode. Short, flat, not rude.

Name: Weapon_Pickup
Description: A pipe, plank or crowbar picked up out of a smashed crate.

Name: Weapon_Swing
Description: An armed punch cutting air. Heavier than Whoosh_Heavy and with the object's own sound: pipe ring, plank whip.

Name: Weapon_Hit
Description: An armed punch landing. Steel or wood on body.

Name: Weapon_Break
Description: The last use spent: the plank splitting, the pipe clanging away.

Name: Crate_Break
Description: A crate or barrel giving way. Wood splintering, or a barrel's hollow clang.

Name: Pickup_Health
Description: The skewer. Warm, quick.

Name: Pickup_Rage
Description: The rage orb. A charge taken in; a little electric.

Name: Music_Stage
Description: The fight loop. One track per theme is the intent; start with one and cast per stage later.

Name: Music_Menu
Description: The title screen. Slower than the fight loop, same key.

Name: Music_Boss
Description: The two title fights. The stage loop with the floor taken out.
